news.headline: HP’s HyperX Omen 15 isn’t quite the budget-friendly gaming laptop its predecessor was
news.summary: HP's rebranding of its gaming lineup means the new Omen 15 is stepping into bigger shoes—literally and figuratively. While it brings genuine upgrades like the RTX 5050 GPU compared to its Victus predecessor, the price tag has climbed from that accessible $800 entry point, making it less of a budget-friendly option for gaming newcomers. The trade-off between improved specs and lost affordability will force buyers to decide if the performance gains justify the premium.

news.headline: My ex-husband’s sister died — so why is Fidelity asking me for her death certificate?
news.summary: When a family member passes, the paperwork doesn't stop—it multiplies. Fidelity's request for a death certificate from someone with no direct account connection highlights a broader issue: financial institutions are caught between regulatory compliance and customer frustration. The real cost? Not just the certificate itself, but the emotional labor of navigating byzantine estate and beneficiary verification processes that can feel unnecessarily rigid.

educational.title: How Interest Rates Actually Move Your Money
points: The Fed sets a target rate that ripples into loans, mortgages, and savings
Higher rates make borrowing pricier — car loans and mortgages cost more
Higher rates also make saving pay better — bank yields tend to rise too
Stocks often wobble on rate news because future profits get discounted more
You don't need to predict rates — just understand why headlines move markets
